summary: scripts/st-test --push confirms with one ls-remote, after every check, that each ref of what its summary calls covered is on the remote; a missing ref is pushed again and reported (on-remote: pushed again), and one still missing fails the run (#4186)

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The run record gains an on-remote row when it pushed.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. What is signed and pushed is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Runs re-execute main's st-test, so this applies to every run once on main.
